records.name: Miglustat / SCARB2-related action myoclonus–renal failure
records.exact_entity: Oral miglustat; historical manufacturer/lot/formulation not authenticated across reports.

evidence.functional_signal: Reported independent walking/feeding regained; serial myoclonus/video follow-up through 24 months.
evidence.contrary: Uncontrolled with concurrent symptomatic drugs; approximately 10 kg first-year weight loss.

evidence.genotype: compound heterozygous c.431_432insAG (reported alias c.435_436insAG) and c.862C>T; p.Gln288Ter
evidence.functional_signal: Reported dysphagia resolution and reacquired tasks over three years.
evidence.contrary: Seizures already controlled; progressive renal impairment with additional urological pathology; uncontrolled.
Both related individuals discontinued following worsening myoclonus/ataxia.

records.exposure_issue: Renal dysfunction is part of the indication; official capsule label has renal dose limits, tremor/neuropathy and gastrointestinal/weight-loss liabilities. A published CNS regimen is not a validated exposure plan.
records.material_model_route: A marketed specified capsule is a future article option; case formulation equivalence and a qualified functional disease model were not established. Biochemical substrate models cannot replace motor/swallowing outcomes.
records.next_decision: Reconcile all treated cases, genotype, renal exposure and independently measured useful function with failures retained.
records.advance_condition: Credible function beyond natural history/cointerventions at acceptable exposure, with a specified product contribution for asset promotion.
records.stop_condition: Reproducible neurological worsening, intolerable required exposure, or biomarker change without meaningful function.
records.disposition: conditional clinical-research reserve below lisdexamfetamine; independent asset thesis on hold
records.allocation: initial diligence within existing five-point discovery allocation

records.name: GSK2193874 / TRPV4-related neuromuscular disease
records.exact_entity: GSK2193874 (GSK219); distinct from GSK2798745, ABS-0872 and ABS-0871/STAR-0871
records.stage: limited motor-neuron soma loss at treatment initiation
records.functional_signal: Reported dose-dependent survival/motor rescue and restored blood–spinal-cord barrier function.
records.contrary: Post-symptom rescue is not regeneration after extensive neuron loss or human heterozygous functional proof. Separate clinical GSK2798745 lung-challenge study missed efficacy criteria despite predicted relevant exposure; this is not a CMT trial.

article_mapping.name: GSK2798745
article_mapping.role: distinct early human PK/tolerability article and negative lung-challenge comparator

article_mapping.name: ABS-0872
article_mapping.role: 2025 cellular barrier research article; identity with ABS-0871 not established

article_mapping.name: ABS-0871 / STAR-0871
article_mapping.role: same clinical program under sponsor-reported rename

records.material_model_route: Public exact probe/model methods and separate cell-barrier work provide a research route; no stock, qualified model, native human functional transfer or rights secured.
records.next_decision: Identify a differentiated exact-article contribution versus the active clinical program before independent development.
records.advance_condition: Useful established-disease function, improved relevant exposure/tolerability, or another concrete contribution with credible development/rights path.
records.stop_condition: No differentiated contribution or failure of qualified exact-article functional proof; do not infer target-class failure from a different-indication negative.
records.disposition: preclinical benchmark and conditional differentiation reserve; hold undifferentiated independent development
records.allocation: initial diligence within existing five-point discovery allocation
